script.title: The Story of The SolarWinds Operators

segments.title: Opening Hook
segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
Every criminal has a story. Today, we're telling the story of The SolarWinds Operators.

Russian state-sponsored intelligence agency (SVR) operating in cyberspace since the late 2000s

But this isn't just a story about crime. It's a story about ambition, power, and the choices that led someone down a path they can never escape from.

What drove The SolarWinds Operators to Gain sustained access to U.S. government networks and critical infrastructure without detection, enabling long-term intelligence gathering on national security matters? How did they rise to power in Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR)? And what ultimately led to their downfall?

This is their story. And it starts here.

segments.title: Character Foundation
segments.speaker: both
segments.text:
The SolarWinds Operators didn't start out as a criminal. Like many people, they had a beginning, a transformation point.

Russian state-sponsored intelligence agency (SVR) operating in cyberspace since the late 2000s

Highly sophisticated APT group with military-grade capabilities, focused on espionage and long-term network access. Known for sophisticated supply chain attacks and methodical operational security.

The core of who The SolarWinds Operators became was shaped by one fundamental drive: Gain sustained access to U.S. government networks and critical infrastructure without detection, enabling long-term intelligence gathering on national security matters



This foundation is crucial to understanding what comes next. Because the choices made in these early days would echo throughout their entire life.
adlibNotes: Ask the guest: "What do you think changed in them?"
Invite guest perspective on the turning point

segments.title: Underworld Integration
segments.speaker: both
segments.text:
This is where The SolarWinds Operators fully stepped into the criminal underworld.

As State-Sponsored APT Team Leader / SVR Cyber Operations Division, they became a key player in Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR).

Their allies included: GRU (Russian military intelligence), FSB (Federal Security Service)

Their opposition consisted of: NSA (National Security Agency), CIA (Central Intelligence Agency), CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency), Microsoft Security Response Center, SolarWinds Security Team

Key relationships in their network: President Vladimir Putin (authority), SolarWinds Development Team (target), U.S. Government Network Administrators (target)

[VERIFY: These relationships need confirmation]

But having power in the criminal world means constant vigilance. Constant pressure. Constant danger.
adlibNotes: Ask about internal dynamics in the faction

segments.title: Cliffhanger
segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
But Act Three - the final act - would be unlike anything that came before.

December 2020 onwards: FireEye discovered the breach, U.S. government response, attribution to SVR confirmed, international sanctions imposed, operation exposed but legacy compromises persist

And that's where this episode ends. But the real drama? That's just beginning.

Next time on this series: We explore what happens when power collapses. When the unstoppable force meets an immovable object.

Don't miss it.

segments.title: Part 2 Recap
segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
Welcome back. You're listening to the story of The SolarWinds Operators.

In part one, we learned how they rose through the ranks of Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR).

We saw Act One: 2019-2020: Identified SolarWinds Orion as high-value supply chain target with access to thousands of government and private sector networks

And Act Two: March-December 2020: Successfully injected malicious code (SUNBURST) into SolarWinds update pipeline, compromised 18,000+ customers including multiple U.S. government agencies

But the pressure was mounting. The contradictions were becoming unbearable.

Today, in part two, we explore what happens next.

segments.title: Narrative Arc
segments.speaker: both
segments.text:
The story unfolds in three acts.

Act One: 2019-2020: Identified SolarWinds Orion as high-value supply chain target with access to thousands of government and private sector networks

During this time, the underlying themes of their life became clear: The vulnerabilities of software supply chains, Nation-state cyber warfare and espionage, The asymmetry between defenders and sophisticated attackers

Act Two: March-December 2020: Successfully injected malicious code (SUNBURST) into SolarWinds update pipeline, compromised 18,000+ customers including multiple U.S. government agencies

This is where the tension reaches its peak. Where the contradictions in their life become unbearable.

[Q&A: What internal conflicts do you think they were experiencing?]

The conflicts were everywhere:
- Internal: Balancing technical sophistication with operational stealth; Managing multiple compromised networks simultaneously; Maintaining security within Russian government structure
- External: Detection risk from U.S. cybersecurity firms; International diplomatic response and sanctions; Technical detection methods from government agencies; Supply chain security improvements
- Personal: Operatives caught in geopolitical tensions; Career advancement tied to operation success; Psychological burden of managing massive espionage campaign
adlibNotes: Let guest respond to Q&A about internal conflicts

segments.title: Resolution
segments.speaker: both
segments.text:
Act Three finally arrives: December 2020 onwards: FireEye discovered the breach, U.S. government response, attribution to SVR confirmed, international sanctions imposed, operation exposed but legacy compromises persist



[Q&A: What do you think was the turning point?]

This is where everything comes together. Where all the choices made earlier converge into a single, inescapable conclusion.

The story of The SolarWinds Operators is ultimately a story about consequences. About how power, once seized, can never truly be held. About how every choice in the criminal underworld carries a weight that compounds over time.
adlibNotes: Invite guest analysis of the outcome

segments.title: Closing
segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text:
The story of The SolarWinds Operators is one of many in the criminal underworld.

But it matters. It matters because it illustrates the fundamental themes we've explored: The vulnerabilities of software supply chains, Nation-state cyber warfare and espionage, The asymmetry between defenders and sophisticated attackers, Unintended consequences of interconnected infrastructure, The shadow world of state-sponsored cyber operations, Trust and transparency in technology

In telling their story, we better understand how power works. How it corrupts. How it destroys.

The SolarWinds Operators is no longer a mystery. They're a cautionary tale.

And that's a story worth telling.

Thank you for listening. This has been [Series Name].
